title: SwifWire core status JSON
description: Returned by swif_core_status_alloc / core_status. Additive fields are optional for older hosts.

last_error.description: Last dial/runtime error; may embed legacy_fallback_hint= when dials exhausted

legacy_fallback_hint.description: Opaque URI from config.legacy_fallback_uri when dials exhausted; host MUST execute

tls_extension_order_ready.description: true when craft dial uses pack-ordered ClientHello (chrome/firefox default)

craft_dial_wired.description: true when tls_craft_dial is compiled in

quic_stable_runtime_ready.description: quinn path compiled; still lab-gated via SWIF_ALLOW_QUIC_STABLE

forge_ready.description: byte-perfect forged QUIC Initial; false in 0.5 (lab residual → 0.6)
